Text: Did you know that @KingBootoshi has built a bot in our discord that auto generates these beautiful scenes? 

4 images are created at a time with @BitcoinBoos characters and the community votes in discord for their favorite image to be posted on the page.

We voted for this beautiful master piece today 👑
